question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

499, 498, 490, 463, 399, ?
solution:
Logic : Cubes of increasing number series are subtracted subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4038f8049df59a26b8c306b4f51a688b7825d564fd72c6fe960b072afcbae902.png] 

Hence, "274" is the correct answer.
